G'oya

Filial bo'yicha guruhlaymiz, lekin bitta guruhdan uchta har xil summa kerak. Buning uchun CASE agregat ichiga qo'yiladi: har bir qator uchun "bu qator shu ustunga kiradimi" degan savolga javob beradi. Kirmasa 0 qaytaradi va SUM uni sezmaydi.

Yechim

SELECT branch,
       SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'sale' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS sales,
       SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'return' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS returned,
       SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'sale' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS net
FROM transactions
GROUP BY branch

net uchun qaytarishni manfiy son qilib qo'shish yetadi. Chilonzorda 250 000 + 120 000 - 40 000 = 330 000.

Tuzoqlar

ELSE 0 yozilmasa, mos kelmagan qatorlar uchun CASE NULL beradi. Filialda qaytarish umuman bo'lmasa, guruhdagi hamma qiymat NULL va SUM ham NULL qaytaradi. Namunada Yunusobod shunday: returned bo'sh, NULL qatnashgan ayirma esa net ni ham NULL qiladi:

Noto'g'riSELECT branch,
       SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'sale' THEN amount END) AS sales,
       SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'return' THEN amount END) AS returned,
       SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'sale' THEN amount END)
         - SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'return' THEN amount END) AS net
FROM transactions
GROUP BY branch

SUM(amount) ni sof tushum deb olish ham xato: u qaytarishni ayirmaydi, qo'shadi.
